name: Sharable Form Builder
summary: Form builder app that creates forms, previews them and shares them by URL, built with Next.js, shadcn/ui and Zod.
description: A Next.js + shadcn/ui app for building forms and sharing them by link: add fields (text, email, phone number, file upload), mark them required, preview the form and copy the share URL; input validation uses Zod. The README shows how to run it locally and how to persist forms and their responses in a database for your own use case.
contains: create sharable forms and preview them
copy the form URL to share it
field formats: email, string, phone number; file upload toggle
built with Next.js and shadcn/ui; demo deployed on Vercel
51 GitHub stars; README explains database persistence
instructions for adapting the project to your use case
